name: Hair Cleansing and Conditioning Kit
subtitle: FOR: Hair Fall & Frizz Control
description: Prevents hair fall : The sulfate-free, paraben-free shampoo enriched with Keratin improves hair texture, stimulates skin cell turnover to strengthen the scalp barrier and prevent hair loss. Restores volume : Niacinamide & vitamin B5 work together to improve the appearance of your scalp and hair and increase hair fullness. Reduces frizz : Silk protein, biotin & nicacinamde help repair dry, frizzy, and unruly hair. This trio helps remove the frizz and dryness from the hair strands, makes them smooth and lustrous. See best results in 3 months
usage: How to use (Hair fall Control Shampoo) Step 1 : For nurturing your hair, apply Bodywise's Hair Nourish Oil once a week before wash. Step 2 : Gently massage 2.5 tea spoons Hair fall Control Shampoo on wet hair and scalp with fingertips, to work into a lather Step 3 : Rinse thoroughly, and follow it up with Bodywise's Deep Moisturising Conditioner. How to use (Deep Moisturizing Conditioner) Step 1 : After washing your hair with Bodywise's Hair fall Control Shampoo, gently squeeze excess water from hair. Step 2 : Apply 2 tea spoons of Deep Moisturizing Conditioner uniformly across hair strands and the tip of the hair Step 3 : Leave in for 1-2 minutes and rinse well

list.title: How to use (Hair fall Control Shampoo)
list.content:
Bodywise Hair Cleansing and Conditioning Kit is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.
Step 1
For nurturing your hair, apply Bodywise's Hair Nourish Oil once a week before wash.
Step 2
Gently massage 2.5 tea spoons Hair fall Control Shampoo on wet hair and scalp with fingertips, to work into a lather
Step 3
Rinse thoroughly, and follow it up with Bodywise's Deep Moisturising Conditioner.

list.title: How to use (Deep Moisturizing Conditioner)
list.content:
Bodywise Hair Cleansing and Conditioning Kit is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.
Step 1
After washing your hair with Bodywise's Hair fall Control Shampoo, gently squeeze excess water from hair.
Step 2
Apply 2 tea spoons of Deep Moisturizing Conditioner uniformly across hair strands and the tip of the hair
Step 3
Leave in for 1-2 minutes and rinse well

list.title: Can I use the shampoo on a daily basis?
list.content: You shouldn't shampoo your hair more than thrice a week. Over shampooing your hair leads to damaging your follicles and a dry scalp.

list.title: How does the conditioner hydrate my hair?
list.content: This conditioner includes silk protein, biotin and shea butter which work to hydrate the hair, whilst the clever formulas actually penetrates the hair cuticle, targeting your most damaged strands, and hydrates from deep within the hair structure – instead of just coating the surface! This delivers long-lasting moisture and improves the condition and appearance of dry, damaged hair.

list.title: How often should I use these products?
list.content: The shampoo & conditioner should be used thrice a week.

list.title: Are there any side effects?
list.content: While there are no recorded side effects of any of these products, it is recommended to avoid using a hair dryer to dry your hair post wash.
